Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

A Boeing system that displays engine and system data and alerts for operational and abnormal conditions.

Operational example

Engine-Indication and Crew-Alerting System shows engine vibration warning, following EICAS procedures.
